feature: Buying credits: the credit line, the chip and the paid-today meter (U2b)
note: Plan `2026-10-17-buying-credits-ui.md`, PR U2b; extends `buying-credits.json` (U1). ONE account STATE per run: the sheet reads whatever the signed-in account holds, so a run is repeated with the account reseeded between runs (never bought; a pack of 114 with 0 paid runs today; 17 paid runs; 20 paid runs with the free allowance spent, L5; a pack held and the free allowance spent, L3; a cancelled plan lot with 74 credits expiring in 2 days, L7). PRECONDITION: `PAYMENTS_ENABLED` and `HELP_ME_CHOOSE_ENABLED` on for the account, and `scripts/contact-sheet.mjs`'s `openAccount` step (shell, not page: it presses the header or rail avatar and waits for the credit chip the menu draws). `credits-u2-paid-today` waits for the daily line, which draws only from 15 paid runs in the rolling day: in any state below that it times out, and that time-out IS the evidence the line is absent (P5). `credits-u2-chip-line` waits for the line under the chip and draws only for a cancelled plan within three days (the expiring state). The credit-line surface is Help me choose's submit press, pre-filled so its words are written (the line draws only then); the tuning panel, read band, Fits, Suggested changes and synopsis carry the same `CreditsText` and are in their own inventories. The Low Sun pass is the same rows with the account's theme at Low Sun (Amonkhet), which is the app's default (the `the99_theme` cookie unset); the sheet has no theme option of its own.
